# Louis Belpaire

> Personal blog by Louis Belpaire on AI, marketing, and data from a practitioner's perspective. Performance marketer specializing in AI-driven automation across Paid Media, Creative, and Analytics. Posts cover generative AI evaluation, AI agents, marketing automation, and analytics workflows.

## About

- [About Louis Belpaire](https://louisbel.github.io/resume/): Resume, work history, and contact details.
- [Sports](https://louisbel.github.io/sports/): Ironman and endurance sports race log.
